dedupe_keys.name: sugarloaf island seasonal drone shoreline mapping 2023 2025

description: The Sugarloaf Island team publishes eight seasonal drone surveys of a hybrid living shoreline in North Carolina through a Figshare Plus collection. All nine child items, including a shared metadata template, state CC BY 4.0; the collection itself has no licence field. The article describes raw imagery, RTK GNSS controls, point clouds, digital elevation models and orthomosaics for east and west shoreline segments from summer 2023 to spring 2025. These observations can check erosion, flood-defence or nature-based shoreline change models. A caveat is that coverage follows one project site and seasonal survey dates, not continuous storm monitoring. Elevation products require attention to NAVD88, control-point quality and structure-from-motion errors. A Monte Carlo georeferencing script resides in the separate template child deposit. I read the own collection and child metadata plus article Data Records without downloading large survey archives, reconstructing surfaces or running a shoreline model. No directly related catalogue record was identified. Coastal flood and erosion simulation are potential uses.
